question.text: A merchant banker managing an open offer is required to submit a report to SEBI confirming the completion status of the various open-offer requirements. When must this report be submitted?

answer.text: Within 5 working days of the public announcement
Within 15 working days from the expiry of the tendering period
On a quarterly basis during the offer period

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook requires the merchant banker to file a report with SEBI within 15 working days from the expiry of the tendering period. This report confirms the completion status of the various open-offer requirements, including payment to shareholders and settlement obligations under the SAST Regulations. The Trap: "After completion of all open offer obligations" is broadly correct but lacks the specific 15-working-day deadline that the workbook prescribes. "Before the tendering period" relates to filing the letter of offer, not the compliance report. Note: Source - NISM-Series-IX Merchant Banking Certification Examination workbook (Jan 2026), p. 205.
